known_pitfall_claim: The proof claims that the comma-category composite J⟨k′∘k, id_*∘id_*⟩ can be rewritten as J⟨k∘k′, id_*⟩ using the identity-morphism law.
pitfall_counterexample: Let C be the one-object category with endomorphism group S₃ acting on {0,1,2}; let E and D be terminal categories, forming the comma category (C→E←D). Its morphisms are pairs (u,id). Let J be the first projection. Take k=(01), k′=(12), with (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)). All morphisms are composable and the comma condition is automatic.
